description:
SharePoint Developer 
 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a SharePoint Developer  for a contract opportunity in Nashville, TN.
 SharePoint Developer   Job Details 
 In depth understanding of the capabilities of SharePoint 2010 and 2013
 Expertise MUST include development, migration, administration, management and supporting enterprise SharePoint implementations.
 Hand-on experience with SharePoint 2013 Installation and Administration.
 Hand-on experience with Windows PowerShell and STSADM.
 Hand-on Experience with IIS 7.
 Hand-on development experience MUST include migrating SharePoint 2010 code to 2013
 Hand-on experience MUST include SharePoint to SharePoint 2013 migration
 Strong communication skills and can work w/o guidance or oversight
 SharePoint Developer   Start Date 
 ASAP
 SharePoint Developer   Assignment Length 
 5+ months


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
